purpose: Define the minimum immutable, PIT-safe persistence contract required before MARKET_RV5_CC_SIMPLE / MARKET_RV20_CC_SIMPLE / MARKET_RV_RATIO_5_20 can count as D04 evidence.

sourceContract.sourcePath: TWSE FMTQIK official index path via existing official_source_probes
sourceContract.minimumHistory: 21 official TAIEX closes for 20 close-to-close returns

factorContract.formulaRule: Reuse one frozen versioned computation definition for all prospective dates; no outcome-tuned threshold search.
factorContract.unknownRule: Any missing/late/stale/invalid source or insufficient 21-session history => UNKNOWN; never impute 0 or BAD.

preOutcomeAcceptanceTests: three raw factor observations are present in the same regime snapshot
marketDate and decisionTimestamp exactly match the run clock
A2 source receipt proves same-date official TAIEX availability
pointInTimeEligible is true for every required observation
RV ratio is numerically consistent with persisted RV5 and RV20 under the frozen version
snapshot hash / run fingerprint links are durable and replayable
re-read from persistence reproduces exact raw values and provenance
UNKNOWN remains explicit when any gate fails
falsificationAndBiasGuards: Do not inspect strategy outcomes before capture contract is frozen and first samples are stored
Do not reconstruct first-known historical states from mutable current data
Do not count RV5, RV20 and RV5/RV20 as three independent votes
Do not promote a volatility throttle from descriptive regime association alone
Independent-date, OOS, walk-forward, cost, redundancy and regime tests remain downstream D16/D18 gates

engineeringBoundary.implementationNote: A future isolated research wiring may populate existing regimeFactorObservations and existing storage only after governance authorization; this contract itself changes no runtime.

exactNextContinuation: Create/authorize isolated research-only wiring that computes and supplies the three factor observations from the already-approved A2 official source path.
On first live prospective capture date, perform write/readback/replay verification before any outcome analysis.
Then compare overlapping RV5/RV20 against non-overlapping recent5/prior15 as robustness only.
